title: The sum of digits of polynomial values in arithmetic progressions
notes: Lower bounds for #{n<N : s_q(P(n)) ≡ g (mod m)} when (m,q-1)=1 and deg P ≥ 3. Ordinary q-ary digits and modular constraints. Does not identify the exact correlation s_3(2P(n))=s_3(P(n)), and does not give a finite automaton for that set.
